Tree Board  
Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 4:00 PM  
City Council Chambers, 73 Harlow St. 
Agenda 
 
1. Approval of Meeting Minutes 
a. 07/15/2026 
2. Forestry Division by the Numbers Third Quarter 2026 
3. Forestry Division Staffing Update 
a. Arborist I 
b. Cemetery Sexton 
4. UFMP Final Review/Update 
5. Bangor Beautiful Fall Tree Planting Review 
6. Resident Tree Removal Requests 
a. None at this time.  
7. Next Meeting 
a. Discuss Scheduling 2027 Meetings 
 
8. New Business
Tree Board 
Wednesday,  
July 15th 2026 4:00 PM 
City Council Chambers, 73 Harlow St. 
 
Minutes 
  
In Attendance: 
Tree Board Members: Greg Edwards, Annette Dodd, Karen Marysdaughter, Dominick 
Rizzo  
City Staff: Sophia Cameron- Forestry Technician, Ben Arruda – Forestry Manager 
 
1. Approval of Meeting Minutes 
a. 04/15/26- Regular Meeting 
b. Motion to approve: Unanimous approval. 
2. Forestry Division by the numbers 2nd quarter 2026 & Projects 
a. Benjamin Arruda 
i. 56 SeeClickFix requests closed.  
ii. Preventive Pruning & Paving Pruning 
• 51 streets on this year’s paving list.  
iii. Tree Removals- 
• 18 trees removed by Forestry Crew. 
• 5 removed by Contractor 
• 11 of 18 were dead Emerald Ash Borer infected trees. 
3. Timber Harvesting Update- 
• Prentiss and Carlisle contracted for timber harvesting and 
herbicide application within Twining Pit and City Forest.  
• Invasive species to be controlled before harvesting. 
4. SAF Field Tour of Rolland Perry City Forest. 
a. IFW Managing for Bobolink on old landfill  
5. General discussion of timber harvesting on Twining Pit.  
6. Discussion of Forestry Division joining Planning Committee. 
7. Emerald Ash Borer Injections 
a. 431 trees injected by Forestry division in 2026 efforts. 
8. Municipal replanting efforts explained. 
a. Corridor planting increases visual impact and survivability. 
9. Bangor Beautiful Fall Tree Planting 
a. Discussed sourcing suitable trees for the difficult urban environment.  
b. Discussed invasive species present in Abbot Square Parking Lot 
c. Maine Audubon tree donation.
